cases.prompt: 把这段功能测试用例转成接口自动化：人员01创建并提交R1，R1到审批2（人员02、人员03会签待办）
must: query codebase-memory MCP with project e9
map functional verbs to endpoints
identify class-level @Path prefix
must_not: use Grep or Read on E9 source

cases.prompt: 按功能用例转接口自动化，需要新增 /api/workflow/paService/submitRequest 的封装
must: put new method into existing WorkflowAPI class
keep url variable top and three metadata lines

cases.prompt: 功能用例转接口自动化，submitRequest 已有封装要复用不要重复建
must: reuse existing URL wrapper

cases.prompt: 按功能用例写接口自动化：审批2会签，人员02、人员03各提交一次后流转审批3
must: assert current node via getRequestStatus not submit return code
organize list check before submit and after submit
must_not: assert countersign completion by submit return code only

cases.prompt: 功能用例转接口自动化，流程模板 workflowId 通过运行时动态查找，找不到就跳过
must: locate workflowId via env var or create workflow list keyword
pytest.skip when not found

cases.prompt: 功能用例转接口自动化，人员02会签账号在 config.json 里是空的
must: rely on login_employee auto skip when credential empty

cases.prompt: 按功能用例写接口自动化，先查询当前测试环境已有流程数据并复用，不能重复造数；这条规则也适用于文档、邮件和看板模块
must: query current environment through existing API wrappers before creating data
reuse matching business IDs and anchor subsequent calls to returned IDs
apply the same rule to every module
must_not: duplicate-create data when a matching record exists
hardcode an internal ID from another environment

cases.prompt: 环境里没有目标流程数据，已经查询并反查创建接口但造数失败，请说明缺失数据、已做尝试、真实失败原因和需要人工准备的数据后再继续写用例
must: block executable automation for the dependent case
report missing data, attempts, real cause, and human assistance with continuation condition
do not hide unfinished creation work behind pytest.skip
must_not: invent test data or API contracts
weaken assertions to make the case pass

cases.prompt: 功能用例转接口自动化：查询当前环境没有符合条件的文档数据，请先用 MCP 反查创建、关联、发布接口并尝试完整造数链路，成功后再写目标接口断言
must: confirm live query is empty before creating
use MCP to inspect creation dependencies and execute all feasible steps
continue to target assertions only after creation and verification succeed
must_not: stop at a vague provide-data step without attempting available APIs

cases.prompt: 功能用例转接口自动化写完了，先收集一下用例确认能跑
must: run pytest --collect-only with venv python
must_not: use runpytest.py --clean which triggers sandbox bulk delete

must: do not apply workflow
